svg.text: rx_lna: two-stage LNA, one stage-2 per mixer
stage 1: NMOS pair 10/0.28 ×24 um (the OOK amp_dp, ported), loads 9.143 um ppolyf_u, tail 2/0.5 ×120; the pins sit at vcm (~1.37 V) through Rgp / Rgn
stage 2 (x2i, x2q) gives each mixer its own driver: no I/Q cross-loading; source: sim/rx/rx_lna.py block()
